Hi Aditya / Marissa,

We're lining up final interview panels for Sarah Wu (applied for Senior Infra PM) — she is available next week (Aug 10–14) and is in PST. The ideal slate is: IC behavioral, infra systems design, product deep-dive + debrief. Can you share availability windows (30–60 min slots) you can do next week?

- Candidate prefers mornings (9–12 PST)

Thanks — if you're short on time, tell me who else on the hiring panel we should pull in and I'll reach out.

Best,

Thanks, Maya — quick notes from my side.

I can cover the IC behavioral slot Tue or Thu morning (9–11 PST). I'm out Wed afternoon. I can do the debrief immediately after the interview if it's scheduled back-to-back.

If you need a systems-design interviewer, Marissa is a good fit (cc'd). If Marissa can't make the proposed times, Lauren (cc'd) has offered to pick up overflow in the past week; Lauren, can you cover systems-design Thu morning if Marissa is unavailable?

A couple of asks to reduce re-schedules:
- If a swap happens, try to confirm backups 24h ahead and put a second interviewer on calendar as tentative.
- If the panel load is high that week, consider shifting the candidate to Tue morning to give us more spare capacity on Thu.
